Press Start — unscramble as many words as you can in 60 seconds!

📖 How to use

  1. Press Start — you get 60 seconds.
  2. Unscramble the letters and type the word.
  3. Press Enter or Guess to score points.
  4. Build a streak for bonus points; Skip resets it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many words are in the bank?

110 everyday words across animals, food, places, and objects — a new random word every round.

How does scoring work?

You get 60 seconds. Each correct guess scores 10 points plus a streak bonus, so keep the streak alive!

Can I skip a word?

Yes — the Skip button jumps to a new word but resets your streak to zero.

How do I answer?

Type your guess and press Enter or the Guess button. Spelling must be exact.
